plan: Model the workflow as a deterministic state machine around one public session dictionary.
Validate each action completely before mutating session data.
Build every screen through one helper so prompt, messages, and appointment choices remain consistent.
Keep I/O behind the supplied read_action() and display() adapters.
mechanisms: In-place session reset preserves the public dictionary while restoring exactly four required fields.
Strict type checks reject malformed booleans, identifiers, corrections, and unknown actions without mutation.
A current-prompt helper derives error screens from accepted state.
Appointment dictionaries and emitted choices are copied to prevent external mutation of stored configuration.
run_once() checks both adapters before performing either I/O call.
